title: Launch Announcement — We're Live
prompt: A premium fintech launch-announcement graphic for 'Ongea Pesa'. Deep near-black teal canvas (#0A1A1F) with a large soft radial halo of electric cyan glow (#22D3EE) in the upper third. Centered hero: the glowing Ongea Pesa orbital emblem (cyan core into teal #0FB5A6, soundwave arcs, green-to-cyan orbit ring) with a faint comet point traveling the orbit. Below, the white 'ONGEA PESA' wordmark in geometric uppercase, and beneath it a bold short headline 'SPEAK. SEND. DONE.' in clean uppercase. Near the bottom edge, small: 'Now live · Built in Nairobi by NSAIT'. Lots of negative space, cinematic, minimal, app-launch energy, perfectly spelled. A faint waveform line crosses the lower third in signal green.
negative_prompt: purple background, microphone, dollar sign, stock people, busy layout, lots of text, lorem ipsum, neon clutter, low-res, distorted text, multiple logos
notes: The flagship launch post. Export 4:5 for feed and a 1:1 crop for grid.
